Phillis Wheatley, Poems on Various Subjects, Religious and Moral
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/phillis-wheatley/poems-on-various-subjects-religious-and-moral

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Phillis Wheatley, the author, died 1784.

First publication of the text used: 1773 (SE colophon: 'Poems on Various Subjects, Religious and Moral was published in 1773 by Phillis Wheatley.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1773, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1868.
- Country of origin: every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so this text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die did so in 1784.
